mcpTools.description: Return MCP adapter and knowledge-store health details.

mcpTools.name: aitg_auto_close_findings
mcpTools.description: Auto-close findings whose subsequent runs show N consecutive passes. Keeps the open-findings list signal-rich.

mcpTools.description: Run a heuristic AITG classifier (prompt injection / canary leak / toxicity) on arbitrary text without persisting. Use for self-review before sending.

mcpTools.description: Run WoW pass-rate drift detection. Creates aitg_drift_alerts rows when a test drops below threshold.

mcpTools.description: Fetch one automation by id (continuous_heartbeat, daily_reflection, nightly_full_sweep, drift_detection, auto_close_findings, runtime_sentinel, pr_gate, callsite_guard_default).

mcpTools.name: aitg_get_coverage
mcpTools.description: Read pass-rate per AITG test over a sliding window. Use for periodic self-assessment.

mcpTools.name: aitg_get_trust_score
mcpTools.description: Single weighted trust score (0..100) across all enabled AITG tests. Use as the headline metric for self-evaluation.

mcpTools.name: aitg_health_summary
mcpTools.description: One-shot self-orientation: trust score, total runs, open findings, open drift alerts, last reflection. Call at session start.

mcpTools.name: aitg_list_automations
mcpTools.description: List every AITG automation with mode (automated/manual/disabled), schedule, parameters, last run. Operator-side: read-only view of the DB-controlled cadence.

mcpTools.name: aitg_list_open_findings
mcpTools.description: List failed AITG findings without remediation, ordered by severity. Use to discover what to fix next.

mcpTools.name: aitg_next_in_queue
mcpTools.description: Read the adaptive scheduling queue: which tests should run next based on staleness × severity + recent failures + open drifts.

mcpTools.name: aitg_observe_trend
mcpTools.description: Read your own reflection history (chronological). Use to remember your trajectory across sessions.

mcpTools.name: aitg_propose_payload
mcpTools.description: Propose a new adversarial payload to the corpus. Stays pending until admin approval; does NOT activate without human review.

mcpTools.name: aitg_propose_remediation
mcpTools.description: Attach a remediation proposal to an open finding. Proposal goes through the existing approval gate before any code change.

mcpTools.name: aitg_record_automation_run
mcpTools.description: Workflow callback after execution: updates last_run_at + last_run_status. Not for direct user invocation.

mcpTools.name: aitg_record_reflection
mcpTools.description: Append a reflection diary entry: short narrative + proposed actions. Auto-populates trust delta and counts from the live state.

mcpTools.name: aitg_request_waiver
mcpTools.description: Request a time-bound waiver for a failing test. Auto-expires; requires justification ≥ 20 chars.

mcpTools.name: aitg_run_test
mcpTools.description: Execute a single AITG runtime probe (AITG-APP-01/03/12, AITG-DAT-02) by dispatching svc-aitg-probes. Use to verify a specific suspected weakness.
